contests.title: Urbandale — Measure U: Police station financing

provenance.quote: Shall the City of Urbandale, State of Iowa, issue its General Obligation Bonds or Capital Loan Notes in an amount not exceeding the amount of $25,000,000 for the purpose of paying costs of designing, constructing, equipping, and furnishing a new police station, with related site improvements?

measures.questionText: Shall the City of Urbandale, State of Iowa, issue its General Obligation Bonds or Capital Loan Notes in an amount not exceeding the amount of $25,000,000 for the purpose of paying costs of designing, constructing, equipping, and furnishing a new police station, with related site improvements?

provenance.quote: Shall the City of Urbandale, State of Iowa, issue its General Obligation Bonds or Capital Loan Notes in an amount not exceeding the amount of $25,000,000 for the purpose of paying costs of designing, constructing, equipping, and furnishing a new police station, with related site improvements?

measureRecords.whatItDoes: Authorizes up to $25 million in general-obligation bonds or capital loan notes to design, construct, equip and furnish a new police station and make related site improvements.
